en.short_description: Track your cycle, symptoms, pregnancy and menopause. Logs stay on your device.
en.description:
HerJourney is a women's health tracker that follows you through four stages of life, and keeps what you log on your own device.

—— Four journeys ——

CYCLE
Log your period, flow, symptoms and mood. Logging the first day of a new period updates your predictions, so the calendar shows where you are in your cycle — menstrual, follicular, ovulation or luteal — along with your estimated next period and fertile window.

TRYING TO CONCEIVE
An estimated fertile window worked out from your own period date and cycle length, an ovulation calculator, and a place to record ovulation test results.

PREGNANCY
Enter your due date to see how many weeks along you are and which trimester you are in. A due-date calculator works it out from your last period. Log pregnancy symptoms such as nausea, back pain and swelling.

MENOPAUSE
Log hot flashes, night sweats, sleep trouble, mood changes and other symptoms of perimenopause and after, in the same place as everything else.

—— Log what matters ——

• Period flow, symptoms, mood and intimacy, each with an optional note
• A day-by-day history of the last 90 days of entries, where you can delete any of them
• Cycle and period length you can adjust, and a last-period date you can correct

—— Works with Apple Health and Health Connect ——

Grant access once and the Vitals screen shows today's steps, heart rate, HRV, sleep, blood oxygen, body temperature, active energy and weight from your phone or watch. Period flow you log and the weight you save in your profile are written back, so your other health apps stay in step. Declining leaves every other feature working.

—— Your data stays with you ——

Everything you log is written to a database on your device, and nothing you log is uploaded. Firebase is used for crash reports, performance monitoring and app usage statistics; the app does not send the entries you log to it. Signing in with Apple or Google is entirely optional and is not required to use anything.

—— Ads ——

HerJourney is free and shows ads from Google AdMob. Google may use device identifiers to serve and measure ads; the app does not ask for permission to track you across other companies' apps, and where the law requires it you are asked for consent first and can change your choice later under Profile → Privacy choices. Nothing you log is shared with Google or any ad network.

—— Not medical advice ——

HerJourney is an education and self-tracking tool. It is not a medical device, it does not diagnose anything, and it is not contraception. Estimated fertile windows and due dates are calculations from the dates you enter, not clinical predictions. Talk to a clinician about any decision concerning your health.
en.full_description:
HerJourney is a women's health tracker that follows you through four stages of life, and keeps what you log on your own device.

FOUR JOURNEYS
• Cycle — log period, flow, symptoms and mood; a new period updates your predicted next period, phase and fertile window
• Trying to conceive — an estimated fertile window, an ovulation calculator and ovulation test logging
• Pregnancy — weeks and trimester from your due date, a due-date calculator, and pregnancy symptom logging
• Menopause — log hot flashes, night sweats, sleep and mood through perimenopause and after

LOG WHAT MATTERS
• Period flow, symptoms, mood and intimacy, each with an optional note
• A day-by-day history of the last 90 days of entries, where you can delete any of them
• Adjustable cycle and period length, and a last-period date you can correct

WORKS WITH APPLE HEALTH AND HEALTH CONNECT
Grant access once and the Vitals screen shows today's steps, heart rate, HRV, sleep, blood oxygen, body temperature, active energy and weight. Period flow you log and the weight you save in your profile are written back so your other health apps stay in step. Declining leaves every other feature working.

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
Everything you log is written to a database on your device, and nothing you log is uploaded. Firebase is used for crash reports, performance monitoring and app usage statistics; the entries you log are not sent to it. Signing in with Apple or Google is optional and is not required for any feature.

ADS
HerJourney is free and shows ads from Google AdMob. Google may use device identifiers, such as your advertising ID, to serve and measure ads. Where the law requires it you are asked for consent first, and you can change your choice under Profile → Privacy choices. Nothing you log is shared with Google or any ad network.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
HerJourney is a women's health tracker that follows you through four stages of life, and keeps what you log on your own device.

Intended audience:
Cycle, pregnancy, menopause

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
No account and no login are required. On first launch a short onboarding asks for a first name, age, current journey (Cycle, Trying to Conceive, Pregnancy or Menopause) and cycle details; every step can be skipped. After that the app opens on four tabs:
- Home: current cycle phase and days until the next period, and Quick Log (period, symptoms, mood, intimacy) with a History button that lists the last 90 days of entries and lets you delete any of them
- Health: pick a journey to see its log tiles and tools (ovulation calculator, due-date calculator)
- Vitals: tap Connect Health App to grant Apple Health access and see today's steps, heart rate, HRV, sleep, active energy, body temperature, blood oxygen and weight
- Profile: name, journey, cycle and period length, last period start, and the optional Account section

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Supabase — optional sign-in only (Sign in with Apple, Google Sign-In). Nothing the user logs is uploaded; logs stay in a database on the device.
- Apple HealthKit (Health Connect on Android) — reads steps, heart rate, HRV, sleep, active energy, body temperature, blood oxygen and weight after the user grants access; writes the period flow the user logs and the weight saved in Profile. Declining leaves every other feature working.
- Firebase Crashlytics, Performance Monitoring, Analytics and Remote Config — crash reports, performance and app usage statistics. The entries the user logs are not sent to Firebase.
- No advertising SDK.
- Google AdMob (ads): banner and occasional interstitial ads served by Google. Google may use device identifiers to serve and measure ads; the app does not track users across other companies' apps or websites. Where required (EEA, UK, Switzerland) consent is requested before any ad, and the choice can be changed under Privacy choices in the app.

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app's text is in English only. Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
An account is optional: Profile tab > Account (Optional) > Continue with Apple or Continue with Google. Once signed in, account deletion is in the app: Profile tab > Account (Optional) > Delete account, then confirm with Delete permanently. The app calls the delete_user function on our Supabase project, which deletes the signed-in account, and then signs out. If that call fails (offline, or the server function not yet deployed, internal ticket MA-044) the app shows the real error, keeps the user signed in and does not report a deletion. Logs on the device were never uploaded and are not part of the account.
